Few steps. Full definitions stay on [Glossary](glossary.qmd); citeable status stays on [Official status](tracker.qmd).

## Start the week

- [Lectures](lectures.qmd) — slide PDFs and takeaways  
- [Readings](readings.qmd) — documents by week  
- Map of all twelve weeks: [Course overview](overview.qmd)

## Learn the vocabulary (short)

- [What is LAE?](primer.qmd) — plain-language scope  
- [Who decides what?](regulators.qmd) — one-line regulator roles  
- First-use shortcuts: [Sandbox X](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) (advanced trial programme, ≠ first Sandbox); [Cap. 448G](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law) (HK small unmanned aircraft Order); [CASK](glossary.qmd#business-and-economics) (cost per available seat-kilometre — lecture tool, not a data series)

## Check what you may cite

- [Official status](tracker.qmd) — [OPEN]{.status-chip .status-open} / [WATCH]{.status-chip .status-watch} / [settled]{.status-chip .status-settled} labels  
- [Timeline](dates.qmd) — dated instruments  
- [Glossary](glossary.qmd) — terms and diagrams  

## Optional later
